description: This file contains functions and constants for batching and inserting large documents into Feishu via its Descendant API, handling splitting large content into manageable batches while maintaining parent-child relationships.

methods.name: normalizeChildIds
methods.description: Normalizes the children property of a block to an array of strings.

methods.name: toDescendantBlock
methods.description: Converts a FeishuDocxBlock into a Descendant API compatible block, including handling children.

methods.name: collectDescendants
methods.description: Recursively collects all descendant blocks starting from a root ID.

methods.name: insertBatch
methods.description: Inserts a single batch of blocks into a document using the Descendant API.

methods.name: insertBlocksInBatches
methods.description: Splits large sets of blocks into batches respecting API limits and inserts them sequentially.
